digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities and model configuration (Bedrock and Anthropic adapters)
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but omits claude-opus-4-8 (the DEFAULT_MODEL), leaving the default model unguarded against temperature rejections

Both us.* and global.* Bedrock profile prefixes reject temperature and top_p parameters on opus-4-8 and opus-4-7, but the table keys on full model id so both prefixes must be covered explicitly or matched on family

The direct Anthropic path (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) also rejects temperature, causing pydantic-ai to silently drop the parameter and emit warnings instead of failing with 400, making determinism assumptions in greedy-decode passes unverifiable
Temperature parameter rejection is not absolute: temp=1.0 (the API default) succeeds on opus-4-8 while temp=0.0 and temp=0.5 fail, indicating tunability is deprecated not support
Code-review Pass-2 deliberately pins temperature=0 for determinism but has been resampling in production because the temperature parameter was being silently dropped on the Anthropic adapter
